Rationale: a maintainer-direct task (filing gate ③), with the instruction quoted in the body with who and where (「开卡吧，skills 判档那个」). The measured cost is a whole shift of dev and reviewer runs at the ceiling tier on cards with no mandatory-clause hit, caught at 94% of the fable weekly quota. p2: it burns the scarcest quota fleet-wide, with no correctness effect. `finding` removed.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f` · 2026-09-27T16:31Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. **G3 is narrower than the card states.** `execution-duties.md:107` already reads 「降档出口两条:额度耗尽豁免,与主动预降(余量吃紧可预先降档)」, so moving DOWN on a quota wall is written. What is missing is the other half: nothing says ⛔ never UP, and nothing makes a temporary deviation expire. G3 is one clause added to `:107`, not a new rule.

**Execution notes.**
1. G1 is the core. Answer `--tier` for a sister repo from the path globs alone (`MANDATORY_TIER_GLOBS` / `SUSPECT_TIER_GLOBS`), without deriving the gate family. Without it, G2 has nothing to check a sister-repo claim against.
2. G2 builds on G1: the claim reader refuses a `Container & model:` line naming the ceiling tier unless it names a mandatory-clause hit or a per-card reason. Same mechanism as the `Thread-read:` refusal.
3. G4 is a different reader (the review brief and record, not the claim). The skills seat may split it into its own card if one PR would not stay reviewable. If it stays here, the `Local-runs:` line goes into `record-recognisers.mjs --template`, so it is checked, not only written.
4. The SKILL.md line ratchet applies. Any SKILL.md text is paid for by deletion. `.claude/**` protocol surface ⇒ the skills seat's contract-review tier review before landing (clause ①, as the card says).

**Neighbour, not folded:** #19603 (`pm:dispatched`, in flight) is a seat's own report of reviews run at a retired tier. Same tier-discipline family, but a different gap (the reviewer tier fuse, not the claim line), and in-flight cards are never folded.

The H17 index (anchor #9857, swept 2026-09-21) names `dispatch-gates.mjs` as a `Restart-touch:` file of #14290, which closed `not_planned` on 2026-09-23 ⇒ no rider. The neighbour #19603 (in flight, the reviewer-tier fuse) is not folded, per triage.
